traits: Filamentous ascomycete mould; it does not form a cap-and-stem mushroom.
Used as a ripening culture in blue-veined cheeses, including Roquefort.
Strains can differ in colour, aroma and secondary metabolites, including mycotoxins.
safetyNote: Selected strains are used in controlled production of blue-veined cheeses. Strains and production conditions differ; seeing blue-green mould elsewhere does not identify it or establish that it is safe. This profile describes the fungus and is not a food-safety assessment.
